english.name: The Entity
english.description: What is the entity?

schinese.name: 神秘存在
schinese.description: 这神秘存在到底是什么?

english.name: Big Crunch
english.description: Grow so large you absorb the whole universe.

schinese.name: 宇宙大爆炸
schinese.description: 一直变大,直到把整个宇宙都吸收了.

english.name: Elite
english.description: Make a 6 star system.

schinese.name: 精英
schinese.description: 建造一个有6颗恒星的星系.

english.name: Supremacy
english.description: As a star have an orbiting life planet with 100 kills.

schinese.name: 霸权
schinese.description: 一个恒星获得了一个消灭了100个单位的行星.

english.name: Asteroid Nursery
english.description: Have 15 asteroid moons around your planet.

schinese.name: 小行星温床
schinese.description: 你的行星周围有15颗小行星卫星

english.name: Overcrowding
english.description: Get the maximum possible life in your system.

schinese.name: 人口过剩
schinese.description: 在你的星系中装满尽可能多的生命体.

english.name: Super Clock
english.description: Get 10 planets in your system orbiting clockwise.

schinese.name: 超能时钟
schinese.description: 在你的星系中放置10颗顺时针绕行的行星.

english.name: Betrayal
english.description: Grow to a black hole from a multi star system.

schinese.name: 终究错付了
schinese.description: 从多星系统成长为黑洞.

english.name: Flying Blind
english.description: Go from a brand new black hole to Big Crunch without dying or respawning. No god options.

schinese.name: 蒙眼飞行
schinese.description: 从新生黑洞一路发展到宇宙压缩, 全程不能死亡或重生. 不用上帝模式.

english.name: Speed Cycle
english.description: Go from Big Bang to Big Crunch in under 20 minutes. No god options or respawning in a menu.

schinese.name: 快速循环
schinese.description: 20分钟内从宇宙大爆炸发展到终极压缩. 不用上帝模式且不可通过菜单重生.

english.name: Gentle But Firm
english.description: Complete the 2nd part of the "Fine Art" mission without dying and without evolved life on your planet or god options.

schinese.name: 轻柔但是坚固
schinese.description: 在不死亡且行星无进化生命、不用上帝选项的前提下完成"Fine Art"任务第二部分.

english.name: Ninja
english.description: Complete each of the "Assassin" mission parts without dying and no god options.

schinese.name: 忍者
schinese.description: 没有死亡,且不用上帝选项完成"Assassin"的所有任务.

english.name: I Got This
english.description: Kill all the attacking ships in the first part of the "Heist" mission before completing it. No god options.

schinese.name: 我明白了
schinese.description: 在完成"Heist"任务第一部分前击毁所有来袭飞船. 不用上帝选项.

english.name: Hobo Star
english.description: Start the 3rd part of the "Duel" mission as a single star, no planets, no god options and beat it in under 3 minutes.

schinese.name: 恒星流浪者
schinese.description: 以单恒星无行星状态开启"Duel"任务第3部分,不用上帝选项并在3分钟内完成.

english.name: I'm Late!
english.description: Complete the first part of the "Concert" mission in under 1 minute and with no god options.

schinese.name: 我迟到了!
schinese.description: 1分钟内完成"Concert"任务第一部分且不用上帝选项.

english.name: Planetary Soloist
english.description: Complete the second part of the "Concert" mission with no evolved life on your planet and with no god options.

schinese.name: 行星独奏家
schinese.description: 在行星无进化生命且不用上帝选项条件下完成"Concert"任务第二部分.

english.name: Why did you kill me?
english.description: Why?

schinese.name: 你为什么要杀了我?
schinese.description: 为什么?

english.name: Get Lost
english.description: Get Lost.

schinese.name: 迷失
schinese.description: 消失吧.

english.name: Grind Star
english.description: Make a 40 star system.

schinese.name: 星球苦工
schinese.description: 打造40颗恒星的星系.

english.name: Dude, I Don't Suck!
english.description: Beat all the missions without using God options.

schinese.name: 兄弟,我不菜!
schinese.description: 全程不用上帝选项通关所有任务.

english.name: Dark Champion
english.description: Beat the final boss as a dark matter star. No god options.

schinese.name: 暗黑冠军
schinese.description: 以暗物质星形态击败最终BOSS且不用上帝选项.

english.name: Master Thief
english.description: Steal 10 planets on the "Planet Stealer" challenge mission.

schinese.name: 偷窃大师
schinese.description: 在"Planet Stealer"挑战任务中偷取10颗行星.

english.name: Challenge Novice
english.description: Complete every challenge mission with any score.

schinese.name: 挑战新人
schinese.description: 以任意评分完成所有挑战任务.

english.name: Challenge Pro
english.description: Complete every challenge mission with a hard level score.

schinese.name: 挑战专家
schinese.description: 以困难难度评分完成所有挑战任务.

english.name: Snowflake Star
english.description: Get 4 points in the star challenge mission "Snowball Fight".

schinese.name: 冰冻星球
schinese.description: 在"Snowball Fight"挑战任务中获得4分.
